name: Team Squirtle: Sevii Tides Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago & Rocket Warehouse raid — 4x Ground execution, Aerial Flying striking, Electric speed sweeping, Levitate Ground immunity, and Intimidate Attack reduction.
gym_duel_rationale: No gym duel in Chapter 21. All six party members deploy together in full 6-member syndicate raid configuration, storming the Rocket Warehouse to confront Executive Ariana and recover the stolen Sapphire under the Level 80 cap.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 80. Flying typing grants complete immunity to ground moves. STAB Drill Peck lands heavy super-effective damage on Tangrowth/Vileplume.
486 BST speed sweeper. Soft Sand-boosted STAB Earthquake lands fatal 4x super-effective devastation to annihilate Arbok/Houndoom. STAB Discharge sweeps Water Labyrinth water spawns.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 79. Water Absorb completely negates opposing water attacks across the Water Labyrinth. STAB Hydro Pump douses Arbok/Houndoom with heavy damage.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Blunts enemy physical Attack on entry. STAB Close Combat crushes Skarmory/Combusken with massive force. Glare secures 100% paralysis on fast threats.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to ground moves via Levitate. STAB Psychic decimates Ariana's Tangrowth/Vileplume and Arbok/Houndoom for swift, decisive knockouts.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. Thick Fat halves incoming Fire attacks from Houndoom fusions. RestTalk loop absorbs deep-sea and warehouse status.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control against wild encounters.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail for Water STAB coverage.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin for tactical versatility across route encounters.
